key_highlights: ASX volatile: rate-hike bets on rising oil prices pressured banks, while energy and miners rallied intraday (net modest gain)
Iron ore in sustained downtrend, pressuring BHP, RIO, FMG; BHP under strategic review pressure
Hormuz Strait escalation spiking oil, boosting Santos, Woodside, and broader energy complex
Gold at record highs; Forrestania, Kaiser, Aureka, Larvotto all reporting positive project milestones
Property sector facing 'GFC moment' as mortgage costs drive second-job uptake and living standards decline
Big four banks (CBA, ANZ, NAB, WBC) under pressure from rate-hike expectations and margin compression
Qantas $35M redundancy payout signals ongoing airline sector restructuring
US midterms and Trump policy uncertainty adding global equity volatility

sectors.trend: Iron ore in structural decline ('drowning, not waving'); BHP under existential strategic pressure. Gold counter-cyclical strength supports junior miners. NT cattle station sale signals agribusiness stress.
sectors.implications: BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX face earnings downgrades on iron ore. Gold miners (FOR.AX, KAL.AX, AUK.AX, LRV.AX) offer relative strength. Diversify away from pure iron ore exposure.

sectors.trend: Hormuz Strait escalation driving oil spike; Santos under regulatory/political pressure but benefiting from price. Gas cartel dynamics shifting.
sectors.implications: STO.AX, WDS.AX, XVG.AX benefit from oil/gas price surge. Santos faces reputational risk but revenue tailwind. Monitor LNG contract repricing.

sectors.trend: Rate-hike bets compressing bank valuations; NIM pressure vs. credit risk. Qantas $35M payout highlights corporate restructuring costs.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, ANZ.AX, NAB.AX, WBC.AX under pressure. Higher rates support NIM but raise credit losses. Property GFC fears elevate mortgage default risk.

sectors.trend: Property industry facing 'GFC moment'; mortgage stress driving second-job uptake. NZ house price crash returning as regional comparator.
sectors.implications: REITs (GPW.AX, ICPS.AX, DGL.AX) face occupancy and valuation risk. Residential builders under pressure. Defensive rotation into infrastructure REITs.

sectors.trend: Medical institute fund misappropriation scandal; tobacco tax political fight; living standards squeeze hitting discretionary spend.
sectors.implications: CSL.AX, WES.AX, WOW.AX relatively defensive. Tobacco tax debate (BAT, JTI) creates policy risk. Consumer staples outperform in rate-hike environment.

sectors.trend: Nvidia AI dominance, Apple on-device AI pivot, Salesforce AI revenue recovery. BlackRock integrating Bitcoin into institutional flows. US midterms adding uncertainty.
sectors.implications: ASX tech exposure limited but global risk-on/off flows impact AUD and capital inflows. Monitor NVDA, AAPL, CRM as global sentiment proxies.

key_themes: Iron ore structural decline vs. gold cyclical strength in mining complex
Hormuz Strait geopolitical risk as primary oil price driver
RBA rate-hike expectations pressuring banks and property simultaneously
Living standards collapse: mortgage stress, second jobs, public sector dependency
Property sector 'GFC moment' narrative gaining traction
US political uncertainty (Trump, midterms) as global risk overlay
Gold as macro hedge: record prices, multiple ASX project milestones

risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce BHP.AX/RIO.AX/FMG.AX weightings; rotate into gold and energy miners

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Hormuz Strait escalation / oil supply shock
risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge energy exposure via STO.AX, WDS.AX; monitor AUD/USD as oil spike pressures AUD
Underweight residential REITs; favour infrastructure and healthcare REITs; monitor bank NPL data
Favour short-duration bonds, consumer staples, and dividend-paying large caps

risk_assessment.risk_factor: US political / trade policy uncertainty (Trump, midterms)
risk_assessment.mitigation: Maintain cash buffer; diversify geographically; monitor AUD/USD and commodity correlations
Underweight discretionary consumer; favour WES.AX, WOW.AX, CSL.AX as defensive

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight gold miners on record gold prices and project pipeline
opportunities.rationale: Forrestania 2Moz milestone, Kaiser Tassie expansion, Aureka $8.9M acquisition, Larvotto NSW discovery signal sector momentum; gold as geopolitical hedge

opportunities.recommendation: Tactical overweight energy on Hormuz-driven oil spike
opportunities.rationale: Oil price surge from Strait escalation benefits Santos, Woodside, Xstrata; gas cartel dynamics shifting favourably

opportunities.recommendation: Defensive tilt into healthcare and consumer staples
opportunities.rationale: Living standards squeeze and rate-hike environment favour defensive, dividend-paying names with pricing power

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce iron ore exposure; trim BHP/RIO/FMG
defensive_moves.rationale: Iron ore in structural downtrend; BHP under strategic review; China demand weakening
GFC narrative, mortgage stress, NZ crash comparator; credit risk building in bank books
Hormuz escalation, US midterms, RBA uncertainty create elevated two-way risk

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely range-bound to modestly lower over 1-3 months. Rate-hike bets and iron ore weakness cap upside; energy and gold provide partial offset. Hormuz escalation is key swing factor. Banks under pressure. Expect elevated volatility.
market_outlook.long_term: 6-12 month outlook cautious. Structural iron ore decline, property credit risk, and living standards squeeze weigh on broad market. Gold and energy offer relative strength. RBA policy path and China stimulus are critical variables. Property 'GFC moment' may crystallise by H2 2026.
key_catalysts: RBA cash rate decision and statement
Iron ore price trajectory (China stimulus response)
Hormuz Strait de-escalation or further escalation
Property credit data and bank NPL disclosures
Gold price direction (Trump policy, global central bank buying)

Brent crude and Hormuz Strait shipping status
RBA policy rate and forward guidance
ASX 200 bank index vs. energy index divergence
Gold price (COMEX) and ASX gold miner sentiment
Australian mortgage arrears and property auction clearance rates
NZ house price index as regional leading indicator
